design_condition: Placed along the perimeter parallel to the highway, the volume forms a protected courtyard and maintains a connection to the excavation sites while allowing later extensions at both ends.

positive.statement: The structural and foundation concept is very carefully worked out and takes the essential points of building over the ruins into account.
The calm appearance of the volume and its positioning lead to a good integration into the landscape.
The project convincingly accommodates all functions in one large, homogeneous volume.
The abstract historical reference to the atrium typology makes sense.
The noise-protected interior world goes beyond pure practicality and is convincing in its basic concept.

negative.statement: Delivery is functionally somewhat cramped, and the detached main entrance is not convincing in its addressing.
The distance between delivery and the depot creates long internal operating routes and operational overlays that reveal the limits of the concept.
The architectural design seems somewhat forced and inappropriate to the building's primary function as a place for research and storage.
